description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a vampire count's: a fitted black jacket with long sleeves to the wrist and short tails at the back, a stiff crimson-lined stand-up collar kept below the chin, a dark crimson waistcoat with a row of small silver buttons, a white cravat at the throat, slim black trousers and polished black boots with small silver buckles, and a long black cape with crimson lining hanging from the shoulders to mid-calf behind the body. Seen from behind, the cape covers the back with its plain black outside; its hem follows each step, leaving the boots visible. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
